استنئن (form X)
# اُسْتُنِئْنَ (ustuniʔna) /us.tu.niʔ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَنَاءَ (istanāʔa)
# اِسْتَنِئْنَ (istaniʔna) /is.ta.niʔ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَنَاءَ (istanāʔa)
